question: can i send back something i bought last week
reply: You can return an item within 14 days of delivery if it is unused and in the original packaging. Since you didn't specify the item, I recommend checking your order details to confirm the return eligibility.

question: how many days until the refund shows in my bank
reply: Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

question: can i return a gift card
reply: I'm afraid gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be returned. According to our policy, gift cards are non-refundable items and do not qualify for a return.

question: the product arrived broken what do i do
reply: To report a damaged item, please report it within 48 hours with a photo and we will process a full refund or a replacement. Please include your order number in your report.

question: who pays for sending the item back
reply: Return shipping is free for damaged or wrong items. For other returns, a fee of Rs. 99 is deducted from the refund.

question: how do i see if my return was processed
reply: To check if your return has been processed, please log in to your account and go to My Orders, then select the order for which you'd like to check the status. You can then view the refund status under the Refunds section.

question: how many days will delivery take
reply: The delivery time for standard delivery is 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.

question: i need my order urgently is fast shipping available
reply: Unfortunately, we do not offer fast shipping options at this time. Our standard delivery policy is in place to ensure timely and efficient shipping.

question: my package is very late
reply: If you have not received your parcel within the delivery estimate, check the tracking link first. If there is no update for 3 days, or the delivery is delayed beyond 7 business days, contact support with your order number.

question: is there a delivery fee
reply: There is a flat fee of Rs. 49 for orders below Rs. 999. For orders above Rs. 999, shipping is free.

question: i typed the wrong address can i fix it
reply: To update your saved address, please go to My Account and then Addresses, where you can add or edit your addresses.

question: tracking says delivered but i got nothing
reply: Please wait 24 hours and check with your neighbours to see if the package has been left with them. If it still has not arrived, contact support with your order number.

question: do you ship outside india
reply: We do not ship outside of India. Our international shipping policy is currently only available within India.

question: i want to cancel what i just ordered
reply: You can cancel your order free of charge before it is dispatched. Please contact us to initiate the cancellation process.

question: how can i follow my shipment
reply: You can track your shipment by visiting the "My Orders" section and clicking on "Track Order", or by using the tracking link sent to you via email and SMS once your order is dispatched.

question: it has already shipped can i still cancel
reply: I apologize, but according to our policy, an order cannot be cancelled after it has been dispatched. You can refuse the delivery or return the item after it arrives, but we cannot cancel the order once it has shipped.

question: i picked the wrong size can you swap it
reply: Unfortunately, we cannot swap an item once the order has been placed. To make a change, please cancel the order before dispatch and place a new one with the correct size.

question: i did not get an email after ordering
reply: We apologize for the inconvenience. Please check your spam folder to ensure you received the confirmation email within 10 minutes of placing your order. If you still can't find it, please contact our support team for assistance.

question: the item i ordered is no longer available
reply: We apologize for the inconvenience. According to our policy, if an item becomes unavailable after you order, we cancel it and refund the amount within 5 to 7 business days.

question: which ways can i pay
reply: You can pay using credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, or cash on delivery.

question: money left my account but the order did not go through
reply: We are unable to provide a refund for a failed payment. According to our policy, if money was deducted but the order failed, the amount is returned automatically within 5 to 7 business days. You can check your refund status under My Orders and then Refunds.

question: i see two deductions for one purchase
reply: To help with your concern, please provide us with both transaction IDs for the duplicate deductions. We will process the refund of the extra amount within 5 to 7 business days.

question: where can i download my bill
reply: You can download your invoice from My Orders. Your invoice is emailed after dispatch, and you can also access it from the My Orders section.

question: can i pay when the parcel arrives
reply: Unfortunately, our policy does not allow for cash on delivery for all orders. Cash on delivery is only available for orders up to Rs. 5,000 with a fee of Rs. 30.

question: do you offer monthly installments
reply: Yes, we offer monthly installments (EMI) on credit card orders above Rs. 3,000. This option is available for customers who wish to pay their order in installments instead of a single payment.

question: can i use two coupon codes together
reply: Unfortunately, our policy states that promo codes cannot be combined, so you can only use one promo code per order. Codes cannot be used together, and they are applied at checkout.

question: how do i reset my login password
reply: To reset your login password, please use the Forgot Password link on the login page to receive a reset email. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

question: i want to update my phone number
reply: To update your phone number, please go to Settings and then Profile, and follow the prompts to change your phone number. You will need to verify the new phone number with an OTP.

question: how can i close my account permanently
reply: To permanently delete your account, go to Settings, then Privacy, then Delete Account. Deletion is permanent and is completed within 7 days.

question: my account got blocked after wrong passwords
reply: I'm sorry to hear that your account was locked. According to our policy, an account is locked for 30 minutes after 5 wrong password attempts. You can reset your password by using the Forgot Password link on the login page.

question: how do i sign up
reply: To sign up, please go to our login page and click on the "Create an account" option. You will be asked to provide your email or phone number and verify it with an OTP.

question: where do i edit my saved addresses
reply: To edit your saved addresses, please go to My Account and then Addresses. From there, you can add or edit your addresses as needed.
